attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: The derivation does not normalize arbitrary EF+SAT_U or arbitrary SAT-semantic reasoning to EqSAT+SR constraints. A stronger proof may use search-to-decision, Cook-Levin witness encodings, or formula minimization principles not represented by the finite SR hypergraph K_pi.
steps: Fix Psys=EF+SATeq+SR with SAT atoms Y_u and the source sentence LB(H_N^SAT,N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}).
Reuse the stable beta-zero transfer: if SAT has L_N^c-size circuits, then H_N^SAT has size N^{max{rho,q}+o(1)}, so q,rho<1+epsilon is the valid target-preserving window.
For proofs using only SATeq links, contract touched formulas to EqSAT components; the proof verifier is functional over quotient labels, so the cycle-87 quotient residual-code audit applies.

Insert one essential SR axiom Y_u <-> Y_{u0} OR Y_{u1}. The assignment Y_u=0,Y_{u0}=1,Y_{u1}=0 respects every equality quotient but violates SR, so an EqSAT-only parser accepts a completion that is not SAT-semantic.
Therefore full EF+SATeq+SR cannot be classified as occurrence/EqSAT-functional unless the parser also records the SR hyperedge or expands it into occurrence children.

Once SR hyperedges are recorded, the residual object is no longer a linear quotient coset; it is a finite Boolean constraint code K_pi. The correct falsifier is low K_pi-constrained row-parity distance plus the row-patching bound.

For compressed block-SR, any completion-sound occurrence parser for negative parent labels must expose all 2^t leaves or provide an equivalent semantic OR certificate, giving a tunable threshold 2^t=N^alpha.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This is a proof-system classification and no-go for a named extension, not a proof of P != NP or a lower bound for H_N^SAT. It refutes a parser route and supplies a valid constrained residual audit, but the main source lower bound remains open.

assumptions: Nonuniform circuit size is measured on the N-bit source input x; all constants hidden in o(1) are uniform in fixed epsilon,c,d,q,rho.
The generator G_N has circuit size N^{rho+o(1)} and outputs M_N=N^{q+o(1)} formulas of length L_N=(log N)^d.
The proof pi_N and its verifier have size at most N^{kappa+o(1)} and do not contain advice tables for SAT labels or residual bad rows.
SATeq links are equality/equisatisfiability links only; they impose equivalence classes but no OR-type semantic relation.
SR links are real SAT-semantic constraints and are not invariant under independent label flips of quotient classes.
The lower-bound sentence is about the actual SAT interpretation; spoof labels are used only as parser falsifiers, not as alternate claims about real SAT.
definitions: source object: a short EF+SATeq+SR proof pi_N of LB(H_N^SAT,S_N) for H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)), with M_N=N^{q+o(1)} and L_N=(log N)^d.
target object: a fork classification of pi_N as a dense functional label property, an occurrence/quotient transcript with residual row distance, or a genuinely SAT-semantic SR-constraint proof.
controlled interface: proof verifier -> touched formula variables -> EqSAT quotient graph plus SR hyperedges -> induced row-parity residual code.
target-preserving condition: the classification may affect the SAT lower-bound route only when q,rho<1+epsilon, beta=0, and the extraction does not add advice or assume the desired H_N lower bound.

Psys syntax: EF over ordinary propositional variables plus extension variables Y_u intended to mean SAT(u), with SATeq axioms Y_u<->Y_v for named equisatisfiable transformations and SR axioms Y_u<->(Y_{u|z=0} OR Y_{u|z=1}).
essential SR use: deleting or treating an SR axiom as an uninterpreted tautology destroys the derivation of the lower-bound certificate or its verifier acceptance condition.

equations.latex: (Y_u,Y_{u|z=0},Y_{u|z=1})=(0,1,0) satisfies all equality links but violates SR(u,z)

equations.valid_when: Valid when K_pi is the finite system of EqSAT and SR constraints touched by the proof and lambda ranges over Boolean assignments to its SAT atoms.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If every SR axiom in the chosen proof can be expanded into an occurrence transcript whose forced complete rows already exceed N^{epsilon-o(1)}, then this no-go does not block that proof; it instead pays the full-row threshold.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Discharges a named part of the formula-semantic extraction fork: full equality/occurrence parsing is refuted for EF+SATeq+SR, and the surviving proof object is a constrained semantic residual code rather than the cycle-87 quotient code alone.
candidate_lemmas.statement: For Psys=EF+SATeq+SR, where SAT atoms Y_u may use equality/equisatisfiability axioms and the one-variable self-reduction axiom Y_u <-> Y_{u|z=0} OR Y_{u|z=1}, the EqSAT quotient parser from cycle 87 is sound only for proofs whose SAT-semantic use is equality-generated. If an SR hyperedge is essential, an EqSAT-only or occurrence-only parser is invalid: there are quotient-label spoofs satisfying all EqSAT links but violating the SR axiom. The valid replacement object is a finite semantic-constraint residual code, and source lower-bound certificates must prove row-parity distance inside that constraint system.

assumptions: Rows are source inputs x in {0,1}^N; an equality test for one exceptional row costs O(N) gates in the nonuniform circuit model.
The circuit D_N is explicitly charged with all transcript decoding, generator simulation, and any hardwired constrained labels used by the predictor.
The disagreement set R_N={x:D_N(x) != H_N^SAT(x)} has cardinality E_N and is nonuniformly hardwired only through equality patches.
No step claims that existence of K_pi-compatible predictors follows from arbitrary EF+SAT_U proofs; this lemma is a falsifier once such a predictor is exhibited.
definitions: source object: the actual beta-zero SAT parity carrier H_N^SAT and a semantic constraint transcript K_pi extracted from EF+SATeq+SR.
target object: a residual robustness condition strong enough to support a source lower-bound certificate.
controlled interface: constrained label assignment or transcript -> row predictor D_N -> equality patching over the bad source rows.
target-preserving condition: the residual audit is target-preserving only if the patch circuit, bad-row advice, and transcript decoder are all charged in the N-input circuit model.

equations.label: row_patch_bound
equations.valid_when: Valid when D_N agrees with the actual carrier outside E_N explicitly patchable source rows in the same nonuniform circuit model.

equations.label: source_robustness_threshold
equations.valid_when: Valid when the claimed source lower bound is C(H_N^{SAT})>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} and D_N is an admissible constrained residual predictor.

equations.valid_when: Valid when the equality-patching overhead O(E_N N) remains below the asserted barely-superlinear lower-bound threshold.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: The lemma cannot be used unless D_N is an actual circuit predictor for the real carrier or the argument is explicitly framed as a proof-system spoof no-go rather than an upper bound.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Converts semantic-link and SR transcripts into a finite falsifier test for claimed lower-bound certificates; it does not prove the lower bound.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Let K_pi be the semantic constraint system extracted from a Psys proof and let D_N be a circuit-computable row predictor induced by a K_pi-compatible label assignment or by a verifier-normal-form transcript. If D_N differs from the actual carrier H_N^SAT on E_N rows and has size S_D, then C(H_N^SAT)<=S_D+O(E_N N). Thus any proof-mediated source lower bound C(H_N^SAT)>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} must certify S_D+E_N N>=N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} for every admissible constrained predictor.

assumptions: The parser must be completion-sound: every label completion consistent with the transcript must satisfy the parsed semantic axiom.
For a negative parent label, a single omitted child may be set to 1 while all exposed children remain 0, falsifying the OR equivalence.
The compressed axiom is allowed only as a thought-experiment or as an explicitly named proof rule; ordinary local SR corresponds to t=1.
The threshold comparison counts occurrence exposure, semantic certificate size, and residual row patching in the N-input source model.
definitions: source object: a proof using a block self-reduction axiom over t restricted variables inside a polylogarithmic SAT query.
target object: a lower bound on occurrence transcript size or a named semantic OR certificate replacing explicit children.
controlled interface: compressed SR axiom -> occurrence child set -> private leaf spoof -> row-residual patching threshold.
target-preserving condition: the block-SR experiment preserves the beta-zero SAT transfer only when t<=L_N, q,rho<1+epsilon, and the axiom expansion is charged to the proof/certificate model.

equations.label: block_SR_axiom
equations.valid_when: Valid when u has t distinguished variables and the restricted formulas u|a remain inside the named SAT universe or its charged closure.

equations.label: occurrence_exposure_lower_bound
equations.valid_when: Valid when the parser must certify the negative direction of the OR axiom against arbitrary private completions of omitted child labels.

equations.label: block_threshold
equations.valid_when: Valid when t=alpha log_2 N is varied while q,rho,L_N, and the beta-zero target substitution parameters are held fixed.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If the proof system lacks compressed block-SR rules and uses only local t=1 SR axioms, the exponential exposure statement applies only after iterating the local closure and charging every used axiom.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Gives a concrete quantitative thought-experiment for the semantic escape: compressed self-reduction either expands to full occurrence cost or must be audited as a non-occurrence semantic principle.
candidate_lemmas.statement: For a compressed block self-reduction axiom BSR_t(u): Y_u <-> OR_{a in {0,1}^t} Y_{u|a}, any occurrence parser that is sound for negative parent labels under arbitrary completions must expose all 2^t child restrictions or replace them by an equivalent semantic OR certificate. Therefore block-SR is a quantitative semantic escape: if 2^t=N^alpha with alpha<epsilon, omitted-leaf spoofing is patchable; if alpha>=epsilon, occurrence exposure pays the row-forcing scale rather than giving a free parser.

control_decision.pivot_test: Pivot or demote if no finite K_pi normal form can cover the proof rules actually used in candidate lower-bound certificates, or if K_pi-distance is equivalent to proving the desired H_N lower bound.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote only after a proof-quality audit verifies the EqSAT-only no-go, the block-SR threshold, and a formal constrained residual patching theorem with all advice and row charges included.
control_decision.reason: The top proof-delivery item is advanced by refuting the equality/occurrence parser for a named strong proof system and by naming the exact semantic principle that escapes it.

dependency_updates.description: The target substitution bound C(H_N^SAT)<=N^{max{rho,q}+o(1)} remains the valid bridge for q,rho<1+epsilon and beta=0.
Cycle-87 quotient-code audit is now restricted to equality-generated SAT semantics; it is not valid for proofs using SR hyperedges.
Proof-mediated certificates using self-reduction must be audited by constrained row-parity distance inside K_pi, not by EqSAT coset distance alone.
Arbitrary EF+SAT_U may use semantic principles beyond EqSAT+SR, so the top formula-semantic extraction problem is sharpened but not solved.
Dense functional quotient certificates still naturalize; SR-constrained certificates are outside that proof only until a constructive dense extension of the constraint property is shown.

falsifiers: falsifier: an EqSAT-only quotient parser for EF+SATeq+SR is invalid because the spoof labels (0,1,0) satisfy all equality links while violating a used self-reduction axiom.
falsifier: any constrained predictor D_N with S_D+E_N N<N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} defeats a claimed source certificate for C(H_N^SAT)>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}.
falsifier: compressed block-SR with 2^t<N^{epsilon-o(1)} can leave omitted-leaf or omitted-row errors patchable below the source threshold.
falsifier: reintroducing positive target-query exponent beta gives the older transfer cap q+beta c and cannot imply all-exponent SAT lower bounds.
falsifier: nonuniform advice listing the residual bad rows or semantic children must be charged; otherwise the certificate leaks the target lower bound into the source object.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: For alpha<epsilon, omitted semantic leaves or rows are equality-patchable and act as a falsifier for occurrence parsers. For alpha>=epsilon, explicit occurrence expansion pays the full-row scale, so any short proof must be using a real semantic OR certificate rather than the previous quotient parser.
held_fixed_controls: Target SAT query length L_N=(log N)^d, so beta=0 in the substitution theorem.
No advice tables for SAT labels, bad rows, or omitted self-reduction leaves.
Circuit model remains nonuniform SIZE on the N-bit carrier input.
gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The abstract EqSAT quotient audit is now too weak for strong proof systems; a concrete self-reduction experiment separates occurrence exposure from genuinely SAT-semantic compression while preserving the beta-zero carrier.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: A padded beta-zero SAT parity carrier where each generated formula F_{x,j} has t distinguished dummy-or-choice variables and the proof system may invoke the compressed axiom SAT(F_{x,j}) <-> OR_{a in {0,1}^t} SAT(F_{x,j}|a).
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A formal parser theorem showing that block-SR either expands to 2^t occurrence leaves with charged overhead or is represented by a K_pi constraint whose constrained row-distance lower bound is proved without assuming the desired H_N lower bound.
gedanken_experiment_design.varied_variable: t=alpha log_2 N, equivalently the semantic OR fanout 2^t=N^alpha.

branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 88 identifies the first concrete SAT-semantic escape from the EqSAT quotient parser: self-reduction OR constraints are not invariant under quotient-label spoofing. The valid paper move is not another magnification slogan but a trichotomy repair: equality-only proofs use quotient residual codes, occurrence expansions pay row-forcing cost, and SR proofs require a constrained residual-code audit. Low constrained row distance is a falsifier for source certificates; no main P != NP claim is made.

negative_tactic_decision.conflict_target: Claimed parser-to-query extraction for strong SAT-semantic proofs of beta-zero XOR lower bounds, without paying N^{epsilon-o(1)} full-row or constrained-distance cost.
negative_tactic_decision.contradiction_carrier_or_no_go_family: The no-go carrier is the SR hyperedge Y_u=Y_{u|z=0} OR Y_{u|z=1}; quotient labels (0,1,0) preserve equality information but falsify the semantic axiom.
escape_conditions: Use only equality/equisatisfiability SAT facts, so the quotient residual-code theorem applies.
Expand every self-reduction use into occurrence transcripts and prove the forced-row threshold is met.
Provide a nonrelativizing constrained-distance lower bound for the finite K_pi system without assuming C(H_N^SAT)>N^{1+epsilon}.
Keep beta=0 and q,rho<1+epsilon; any positive beta returns to the older transfer-window falsifier.
negative_tactic_decision.exact_negation_or_method_class: Negate the method class of EF+SATeq+SR lower-bound certificates that are advertised as occurrence-local or EqSAT-quotient-functional without charging SR hyperedges, constrained row distance, or full occurrence expansion.
negative_tactic_decision.next_validation_handoff: Send L88.1-L88.3 to pvsnp-proof-complexity-transfer-reviewer for Psys syntax, then to pvsnp-symbolic-complexity-auditor for alpha,epsilon,q,rho accounting, and to pvsnp-inference-quality-controller before paper promotion.
negative_tactic_decision.paper_contribution_potential: Paper-level if written as a scoped theorem: equality-only parser is valid only in the EqSAT fragment; self-reduction is a minimal named semantic escape; constrained residual distance is the next falsifier audit.
proof_obligations: Formalize EF+SATeq+SR syntax, axiom schemas, proof size, and verifier constructivity.
Prove the EqSAT spoof no-go for any parser that omits an essential SR hyperedge.
Prove the constrained residual patching lemma with all transcript-decoding and bad-row advice charged.
For block-SR or iterated local SR, compute the exact occurrence exposure exponent alpha and compare it to epsilon.
Record whether the resulting certificate is functional/naturalizing, occurrence-relativizing/full-row-expensive, or genuinely SAT-semantic.
negative_tactic_decision.reason_for_tactic: Positive-beta substitution collapse is already quarantined; the sharper current risk is that proof-mediated certificates claim an occurrence/EqSAT extraction while using self-reduction semantics that the parser cannot soundly represent.

branch_outputs.next_experiment: Instantiate K_pi for local one-step SR only: bound |K_pi| by proof size, define its row-parity constraint-distance Delta_K, and test whether Delta_K can be reduced to a known SAT promise-hardness statement or whether it is target-equivalent to the desired H_N lower bound.

attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: ExtensionRowRealizer for unrestricted EF+SAT_U^subst: given an arbitrary SAT atom built using extension substitution, compute or certify its generator-row support without row advice and without solving a hard formula-equivalence/SAT-semantic search problem.
steps: Fixed the concrete proof system EF+SAT_U^subst: EF plus SAT atoms, SAT Boolean-composition axioms, congruence for formula equivalence, and extension substitution into SAT atoms.
Encoded the lower-bound sentence LB_N(s) as the usual circuit-size exclusion for H_N^SAT, preserving the beta-zero carrier parameters q,rho,L_N.
Tried the occurrence parser Q_occ(pi): collect row indices j for syntactic atoms SAT(G_N(x,j)) appearing in pi and close under displayed formula-DAG equality.
The induction over pure EF steps is harmless; displayed equality only changes representatives inside the same equality fiber.

The induction fails at the substitution/congruence rule: a single atom SAT(U_N(x,e)) with an EF extension variable e denoting the row selector has semantic support all M_N rows while Q_occ charges one syntactic occurrence.
Repaired the invariant by defining K_pi=SemCl_G(pi), the closure of semantic supports under substitution, congruence, and SAT composition.
Combined K_pi with the sparse residual inequality: if K_pi is subthreshold and a decider D_N handles the uncharged rows, then H_N^SAT has a circuit of size S(D_N)+O(|K_pi|N L_N^c)+N^{rho+o(1)}.
Derived the conditional forced-charge conclusion |K_pi|>=N^{epsilon-o(1)} under the claimed source lower bound and subthreshold residual decider.

Ran the naturalness audit: if the same accepted cluster has logarithmic target projection and DirectClusterSound, it induces a valid large constructive useful property; without DCS, odd-charge Tseitin remains a falsifier.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This proves a route-specific parser obstruction and a conditional semantic-support transfer, not a lower bound for H_N^SAT and not P != NP. It refutes occurrence-only extraction but does not classify all short EF+SAT_U^subst proofs until ExtensionRowRealizer is proved or replaced by a finite countermodel for every possible semantic parser.

assumptions: The generator G_N is uniform and beta-zero: row formulas have length L_N=polylog(N), row count M_N<=N^{q+o(1)}, and the circuit generating G_N has size N^{rho+o(1)}.
The target circuit model is nonuniform Boolean SIZE(N^a) on the H_N input length, and residual patching may hardwire the exceptional row truth tables but no additional advice outside K_pi.
The proof verifier and parser are uniform in N and pi; any nonuniform choice of semantic representatives must be counted as advice leakage and fails the target-preserving condition.
Soundness is ordinary standard-SAT soundness unless DirectClusterSound or SemanticCompletion is separately assumed; ordinary local consistency is not used as a bridge.
The universal-selector counterexample is a parser countermodel, not a short proof of LB_N(s); it invalidates an extraction method rather than deciding P versus NP.
definitions: source object: a short EF+SAT_U^subst proof pi of LB_N(s), where LB_N(s) asserts Ckt(H_N^SAT)>s for H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)).
target object: an advice-free extraction map pi -> Q_pi or K_pi that supports either a functional natural-property audit or a row-forcing/residual-patching theorem for H_N^SAT.
controlled interface: semantic row support Supp_G(A) of a SAT atom A, closed under SAT congruence, Boolean-composition axioms, and extension substitution, written K_pi=SemCl_G(pi).

target-preserving condition: the parser must preserve the beta-zero parameters M_N<=N^{q+o(1)}, L_N=(log N)^d, generator size N^{rho+o(1)}, and the threshold Ckt(H_N^SAT)>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} without nonuniform row advice.

EF+SAT_U^subst has extended Frege reasoning plus atoms SAT(F), Boolean SAT-composition axioms, congruence F equiv F' -> SAT(F)<->SAT(F'), and extension substitution of EF-defined formula terms into SAT atoms.

Supp_G(A) is the set of rows j for which the formula denoted inside A can, under allowed extension substitutions and fixed x, determine or coincide with G_N(x,j) modulo the SAT congruence rules available to the proof.
An occurrence parser Q_occ(pi) records only row labels syntactically displayed as G_N(x,j); it ignores universal row-selector atoms SAT(U_N(x,e)) and is therefore not invariant under EF substitution.

equations.latex: H_N^{SAT}(x)=\bigoplus_{j=1}^{M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)),\quad M_N\le N^{q+o(1)},\quad L_N=(\log N)^d.

equations.valid_when: Applies after the proof system's SAT rules and extension substitutions are fixed syntactically and the closure operations are part of the parser specification.

equations.valid_when: Requires D_N to agree with H_N^{SAT} on all rows outside K_pi and permits nonuniform hardwiring only for the charged exceptional rows.

equations.label: forced_semantic_charge

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If an advice-free ExtensionRowRealizer computes, for every EF+SAT_U^subst SAT atom, either a small generator-row support certificate or a proof of large support, then the no-go downgrades to a positive semantic-parser theorem.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: This is a scoped no-go/repair lemma for the top formula-semantic extraction task: it refutes occurrence-only extraction for full EF+SAT_U^subst and identifies semantic support as the valid invariant needed for any parser theorem.
candidate_lemmas.statement: For the concrete proof system EF+SAT_U^subst, any target-preserving parser for beta-zero XOR lower-bound proofs must charge semantic row support, not syntactic SAT-atom occurrence count. The occurrence parser is refuted by a universal-selector SAT atom whose single proof occurrence ranges over all generator rows. Thus the full formula-semantic fork is sharpened to ExtensionRowRealizer: either accepted proofs have large semantic row closure, or sparse semantic closure gives a residual-circuit falsifier to the claimed source lower bound.

assumptions: Every SAT atom A has an advice-free certificate R_A subset [M_N] such that Supp_G(A) subset R_A and |R_A|<=b_N.
Each inference rule maps certified supports to certified supports with total expansion at most chi_N and is checkable in poly(N,|pi|).
Residual correctness off K_pi is semantic, not merely locally consistent; otherwise the odd-charge Tseitin falsifier applies.
For naturalization, the accepting cluster has O(log N) target-label projection and direct cluster soundness against all circuits in the named SIZE class.
definitions: source object: restricted EF+SAT_U^cert proof pi of LB_N(s) with support certificates attached to every SAT atom.
target object: semantic row set K_pi and either a residual-circuit contradiction or a large constructive truth-table property.
bridge observable: certified support expansion under proof rules, measured by b_N for leaves and chi_N for rule closure.
non-claim boundary: this does not apply to unrestricted extension substitution unless ExtensionRowRealizer supplies the missing support certificates.

equations.label: support_parser_size
equations.valid_when: Valid for restricted certified-support proof systems where every SAT inference has an explicitly checkable bounded-expansion transformer.

equations.label: row_charge_lower_bound
equations.valid_when: Follows only after combining the support parser with the residual patching bound and the stated source lower bound for H_N.

equations.label: log_projection_density
equations.valid_when: Applies when DirectClusterSound turns the accepted proof cluster into a functional property with logarithmic target-label projection width.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Fails if a SAT-composition or substitution rule creates an atom with unbounded generator-row support while the certificate still records only O(1) rows.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Conditional positive bridge: it states exactly what a restricted proof system must provide before the support branch can promote a row-forcing theorem or a natural-proofs obstruction.
candidate_lemmas.statement: In any restricted EF+SAT_U fragment where each SAT atom carries a certified generator-row support of size at most b_N and each SAT rule expands support by at most chi_N, a parser exists with |K_pi|<=chi_N b_N |pi|. Consequently, if the derived residual decider has size below N^{1+epsilon}, the source lower bound forces chi_N b_N |pi|>=N^{epsilon-o(1)}; if the verifier projection is logarithmic and DirectClusterSound holds, the same object naturalizes.

assumptions: The selector bits are ordinary EF extension variables and may be substituted into SAT atoms under EF+SAT_U^subst.
The row-index distribution is balanced enough that fixing lambda bits leaves 2^{-lambda}M_N generator rows up to lower-order terms.
The carrier parameters q,rho,L_N and the source lower-bound threshold are held fixed while lambda varies.
definitions: source object: padded universal-selector generator G_N(x,j)=U_N(a_N(x),j) inside the beta-zero parity carrier.
target object: support charge K_pi needed for residual patching and functional naturalization audits.
varied observable: lambda, the number of row-index bits fixed by the SAT atom or by its support certificate.
bridge threshold: support is large enough for row-forcing when M_N/2^lambda >= N^{epsilon-o(1)}.

equations.valid_when: Valid for balanced row-selector generators where every fixed selector prefix indexes the expected fraction of generator rows.

equations.valid_when: Applies when the row-forcing target is N^{epsilon-o(1)} charged rows and q is the beta-zero row exponent.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Fails for generators with highly unbalanced selector fibers or for proof systems that forbid selector substitution into SAT atoms.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Quantitative thought-experiment lemma used to test whether a proposed full proof-system parser is counting the correct semantic invariant.
candidate_lemmas.statement: For universal-selector row atoms with lambda fixed selector bits, semantic support has size about M_N/2^lambda while syntactic occurrence width remains O(1). Therefore the parser threshold is controlled by semantic selector leakage, not proof length or local consistency.

control_decision.pivot_test: Backtrack if no advice-free support certificate can be formulated for even selector-leakage atoms, because then full EF+SAT_U^subst extraction is outside the current proof-delivery route.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote to the paper proof-audit queue only after proving ExtensionRowRealizer for a named fragment or proving a formal impossibility theorem showing that unrestricted substitution necessarily uses a nonrelativizing SAT-semantic principle outside naturalization and occurrence-row forcing.
control_decision.reason: The cycle makes a contribution-making move by refuting occurrence-only extraction for a named proof system and replacing it with a precise semantic-support obligation and quantitative threshold.

dependency_updates.description: Occurrence-label parser for full EF+SAT_U^subst is invalid because extension substitution can hide universal row-selector support in one SAT atom.
Replace occurrence row count and equality-closed charge by semantic row closure under substitution, congruence, and SAT composition.
Need an advice-free algorithm or proof certificate that computes small generator-row supports or certifies large support for arbitrary EF+SAT_U^subst SAT atoms.
Cycle 87 generator-local semantic closure remains valid as the restricted theorem; cycle 88 explains why it does not automatically lift to full substitution.
If semantic-support extraction plus logarithmic projection and DirectClusterSound yields a functional truth-table property, the result is a valid natural-proofs object for the named SIZE target.

falsifiers: Universal-selector atom falsifier: SAT(U_N(x,e)) has one syntactic occurrence but semantic support M_N, so occurrence row count is not a valid parser invariant.
Shared-DAG equality-fiber falsifier: many generator rows can share a formula-DAG representative, making private occurrence labels invalid outside EF+SAT_U^{occ}.

steps: Fix P_CR-wExt: EF syntax plus SAT_U atoms; each extensionality line carries a witness w, and the polynomial-time checker either verifies w or the line is not Cook-Reckhow-checkable.

Extract from pi an occurrence transcript Q_pi and a quotient graph E_pi whose edges are definitional identity, witnessed formula equivalence, or witnessed equisatisfiability transformations accepted by the checker.
Measure E_pi by the adaptive-cover exponent alpha_ext=max{tau,max_l(a_l+mu_l),max_l omega_l}; this gives a circuit opener for all nonpatched SAT labels at cost N^{alpha_ext+o(1)} per query block.

Apply the private-row spoof lemma: if a row parity is not constant over LocSat(Q_pi/E_pi), then two local completions preserve the proof transcript and flip that row, contradicting row-parity binding; therefore all such rows are charged to ForcedRows.

Construct D_N: generate all M_N SAT queries using G_N, open their quotient labels using the cover, xor them for nonpatched rows, and hardwire rows in F_pi union R_N. The size is bounded by N^{max{rho,q+alpha_ext,max(f,r)+1}+o(1)}.

If this exponent is below 1+epsilon, the claimed source lower bound C(H_N^SAT)>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} is falsified for this carrier. If an extensionality line has no witness, checking its side condition would decide SAT status by comparison with top/bot, so the formalism is a semantic-oracle model.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This is a proof-delivery packet for a route-specific falsifier and model quarantine. It does not prove P != NP, and it does not rule out proof systems whose semantic certificates have genuinely high adaptive cover or whose lower-bound statements use a declared semantic oracle.

assumptions: Model: unrestricted Boolean circuits measure C_ckt(.) as a function of truth-table length parameter N; no nonuniform hard-row selector is allowed except hardwiring the final falsifying certificate for the negative direction.

Quantitative regime: M_N<=N^{q+o(1)}, the generator family G_N has circuit size N^{rho+o(1)}, query length is polylogarithmic in N, and the proof/certificate carrier has adaptive-cover exponent alpha_ext.
Row accounting: ForcedRows(pi) has size at most N^{f+o(1)}, residual disagreement set R_N has size at most N^{r+o(1)}, and each patched row costs O(N) gates by truth-table hardwiring.

Soundness condition: row-parity binding is evaluated after quotienting formula occurrences by witnessed definitional identity and witnessed SAT-extensionality; local soundness alone is not sufficient.
